# /crav1-spark-to-spec

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From one sentence to a spec](../../from-nothing.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-spark-to-spec/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Turn a one- or two-sentence spark into spec.md.

Clarifying questions and the branch choice are one prompt; the branch is asked again alone only when the reply skipped it. The closing decisions are a list, not a question, and a bare `yes` afterwards does not run the next skill (1.90.5).

One-liner → questions → thin `docs/system/` when missing, including `glossary.md`, then `spec.md`, then one index row (greenfield, brownfield feature, or later feature on an existing landscape; new slug unless they extend). An existing landscape is left in place. A missing `glossary.md` is filled. New glossary rows are appended. Existing rows are not rewritten. A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`. That same pass adds what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect. It does not rewrite what is already there. On Azure Repos, offers once to write `work-item.md`.

## Runs when

You have 1–2 sentences. Called by the user.

This is one of the six starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 3 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: The spark, the repo.

Reads the spark and the repo.

## Writes

In short: `spec.md`, a thin `docs/system/` if missing (otherwise one index row and new glossary rows), the picture update, the slice `Synced at` line, `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in, and `Used by` on a quoted note.

Writes `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md`, a thin `docs/system/` including `glossary.md` when that folder is missing, otherwise one index row plus a missing glossary or new glossary rows, and `work-item.md` when the user opts in on Azure Repos. A `repos.md` it writes includes a `## Synced at` section and leaves no Synced at line. When this run read only that slice's code, writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md` and does not touch the `## Synced at` section of `repos.md`.

## Does not

Leaves application code and an existing landscape alone.

Limits and exceptions: extend edits that spec and adds no second index row. A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets its slug in `used_by` and a `Full source:` link; notes are never absorbed (1.61.0).

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-create-feature-branch`](crav1-create-feature-branch.md); [`/crav1-review-architecture`](crav1-review-architecture.md); [`/crav1-tighten-spec`](crav1-tighten-spec.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-create-feature-branch`](crav1-create-feature-branch.md) when the repo already has commits.
